items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, saying
items.claim: Moses was commanded to speak to the children of Israel

items.quote: In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation
items.claim: The children of Israel shall have a sabbath and memorial of blowing of trumpets on the first day of the seventh month
items.object: a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation
